title: LeanC2: Lean 4 formalization of the C2 analytic framework
description: Lean 4 and Mathlib 4 formalization of the C2 analytic number theory framework. Covers operator algebra (branch, genuine, cutoff), meromorphic continuation and identity layers, near-axis transversality and Taylor radius, bulk and edge nonvanishing certificates, glue decomposition geometry, finite height coverage, and the analytic transfer chain to the zeta function.
